steps.content: The halberd never reaches the curtains, struck back mid-flight by a single petal shot from behind the veil.
Ma Ling catches her violently shaking halberd, her hand aching numbly.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: She hasn't even shown herself, yet a single petal carries so much force... This manor master's power is on a completely different level from these "martial heroes." Could that codex really enhance special powers?

When has the mighty General Invincible ever endured such humiliation? Even as you process what just happened, she locks eyes with the Scholar, twists her body once more, and defiantly thrusts her spear forward!

The flying petals strike again, but the General seems to have expected this, twisting her waist to dodge aside. So the assault with her halberd was merely a feint. The real killing blow comes from behind her.
The silver needles between the Scholar's fingers have already been launched amid the earlier chaos.

In an instant, the silver needles pierce half an inch into the gauze curtains! Just as the attack is about to succeed, the next moment, tremendous energy erupts like a volcano, blasting forth from behind the veil.

The tightly sealed doors and windows burst open, as howling winds of the blizzard pour into the hall! Candles flicker throughout the room. Everyone shields their face from the sudden onslaught of snow.
When they manage to open their eyes again, they see that the silver needles have somehow reversed direction, hurtling back toward them with even greater speed and ferocity.

steps.speaker: Xu Shen
steps.content: Get back! The needles are poisoned!
Thanks to his timely warning, the silver needles hit the floorboards at their feet like lightning bolts.

This was clearly a killing strike meant to take lives. Everyone looks up toward the manor master's seat, where the glowing snow highlights that slender silhouette. Still seated, she seems poised, as if she didn't even move at all.

steps.speaker: Xu Shen
steps.content: The manor master's divine skills are truly unparalleled. It seems the rumors of your serious sickness are simply untrue... In that case, we shall humbly seek instruction from you as fellow martial artists. Please forgive any rudeness on our part.

steps.speaker: Ma Ling
steps.content: Enough talk! This is exactly why I came, to witness such marvelous weapons and martial techniques! She has slighted us so, and I'm not one who can endure such treatment! Then let me be the first to test just how strong you are!
With that, Ma Ling surges forward once more! This time it's no feint. She channels her immense energy, using her body as a shield to ram straight into the gauze curtains!
Seeing her courageous act, the others hesitate no longer.

Folding fan. Palm strikes. Hidden weapons. Even haunting strings of musical notes... Various attacks erupt simultaneously from every direction, converging into a deadly torrent that rushes straight toward the plain white gauze curtains.
Sensing danger, you start looking for cover, but notice Shuang'er frozen in place, her wide eyes staring blankly into the air.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Don't just stand there!

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: ...Wow, my first time seeing so many masters! Invincible iron steeds cleave through a rain of silver; peacock plumes bloom, as harp notes make hearts quiver. What a gathering of great heroes...
Before she completes her sentence, you suddenly yank her under the table.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Ouch! What are you doing?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Trying to stay alive.
Sure enough, just as the wave of attacks is about to reach the curtains, a ring of pale green energy suddenly blooms from behind it, accompanied by a low rumble like muffled thunder.

All the incoming attacks are sent back along their original paths by this overwhelming, irresistible force, crashing into the surrounding walls with even greater intensity. The entire meeting hall shakes violently as utensils overturn and wine spills everywhere.

The table you're hiding beneath gets struck by the aftershock of a reflected palm strike, splitting open a half-foot crack. You and Shuang'er hunker down as low as possible, feeling the floor trembling continuously beneath you.

General Ma Ling, who bears the brunt of the attack, goes flying backward like a kite with a severed string, crashing heavily into the wall. Princess Ji's wheelchair gets pushed by the shockwave, sliding straight back before slamming into a pillar. The Scholar's and the Golden Brocade's faces turn deathly pale, each coughing up a mouthful of blood.

Only the Immortal Healer Yin Yansheng, who had slipped behind a massive pillar like a nimble fish the moment chaos broke out, now pokes half his face out. His eyes show no fear, but instead gleam with almost fanatical excitement.

steps.speaker: Yin Yansheng
steps.content: Marvelous... marvelous! This energy is unadulterated, intense, yet controlled. It clearly belongs to someone whose vitality has reached its peak, yet remains perfectly restrained!

The Healer looks ready to risk getting closer for another look, but just as he pokes his head out, a vicious palm strike comes from behind, whistling past his nose tip. With a sharp hiss, it leaves four gruesome claw marks, each an inch deep, in the tough sandalwood pillar.

steps.speaker: Yin Yansheng
steps.content: ...The blow feels bone-chillingly cold and embodies the savage gust of the mountains. This isn't from the girl behind the curtain...?

steps.speaker: Yin Yansheng
steps.content: Wonderful, yet another new guest! Just how many treasures is this manor hiding today?
You look toward the hall's entrance upon hearing this, but there's no newcomer outside the door, only swirling snow everywhere.

steps.speaker: Guest on the Beams
steps.content: Hey, hey! Where are you looking? I'm up here... Tsk, I'm talking to you two hiding under the table!

steps.speaker: Guest on the Beams
steps.content: Got any more wine? I've drunk the entire jar while watching you all grappling around... Burp!

steps.speaker: Guest on the Beams
steps.content: Forget it, I can tell you two don't have any say around here. Hey, you, the manor master! Got any fine wine left? I need a couple of sips to wet my throat!
The entire hall falls silent. After that intense brawl, the heroes are still trying to catch their breath. At this moment, only the person behind the curtains can still respond calmly.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: If you wish to drink, Mountain Lord, please help yourself.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: It's just that my manor's wine has quite a bite to it. I'm afraid it might not suit an uninvited guest's palate.
[Animated CG: Flying Wine Cup]

steps.speaker: Mountain Lord
steps.content: Oh, I don't care much about the wine's taste! As long as there are enough delicious snacks to go with it!

steps.speaker: Mountain Lord
steps.content: I can see you've terrorized them properly. The show probably can't go on now. How boring is that? Hey...

steps.speaker: Mountain Lord
steps.content: Why don't you show yourself and spar with me? It'll be fun!
As the Mountain Lord speaks, she springs forward at the curtains. Her palm cuts the air, only to be deflected as the fabric ripples alive.

steps.speaker: Mountain Lord
steps.content: Now that's interesting!
She curves her fingers like claws, lunging once more toward the figure behind the curtains!
This time, the curtains remain still.
Because behind them...
There is no one.
[Meeting Hall]

steps.speaker: Mountain Lord
steps.content: Ha! Your little voice-echoing trick with that fake shadow might fool these weaklings, but you can't fool my nose. I knew it from the start—there was never a "tenth person" here.

steps.speaker: Mountain Lord
steps.content: Well, since you've already gathered so many actors for this show... I'll stay to finish this wine! And I'm definitely sticking around for the entertainment!
Declaring that, the Mountain Lord picks up her cup of wine and drains it in a single gulp.

steps.speaker: Mountain Lord
steps.content: You're indeed quite generous, little manor master. You heeded my request and brought in the best snack to go with the wine, haha!
Cheerfully, she sniffs the lingering aroma in her wine cup, then flips around and sprawls back onto the beams casually. But everyone can tell the "snack" she mentioned can't be anything pleasant.

Boom! A thunderous roar explodes from the mountain ridge, shaking the ground and swaying the building frame. The sky suddenly darkens, not from sunset nor clouds, but from the massive curtain of snow raised by the avalanche, like ten thousand white horses stampeding down from the mountaintop.

The entire sky is devoured by the rolling white waves. The sun vanishes rapidly behind the wall of snow. It's as if it has gone from day to night in the matter of just a few breaths. The manor seems to have plunged into a bottomless abyss of snow.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: Since you all insist on claiming this power... then come and take it with your own hands.

steps.speaker: Jichuan
steps.content: I shall await you in the heart of this snowstorm. Come bearing your desires... treading upon blood.

Everyone barely manages to compose themselves from the shock of the avalanche before rushing outside the hall and climbing up to survey their surroundings. Everywhere around the manor is completely blocked by snow. As far as the eye can see, there are only thick white walls that have swallowed the paths, trapping the entire manor in an abyss.
You remember the couplet at the doors...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Hero bones, lone manor?
You catch a rusty stench drifting from the depths of the manor, cutting through the wind and snow.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It's the smell of blood.
[Small CG: Dead Body 1]

Jiewubei's corpulent body lies slumped beneath the guest room's folding screen, murky drool trickling from the corner of his mouth as the smell of alcohol fills the air. A half-finished jar of wine sits by his side, along with several dishes of meat that appear completely untouched.

But upon closer inspection, what fills those dishes isn't food at all. Piled there are the internal organs he spat out: heart, liver, spleen, lungs... all wrapped in mucus and streaks of blood, their shapes still faintly recognizable.
Beside Jiewubei, a note in crimson ink lies half-drenched in a pool of blood:

Red Plum Denunciation I Heavens' mighty gifts squandered at a feast. Can your gluttonous hearts discern the grease? Jade plates brim with oaths long broken; red plums shall witness you feast upon your own organs.
